exact_input: Assign the System Administrator security role to a user in Dataverse.
first_output:
I can’t assign the role from this controlled experiment because live Dataverse connections, authentication, and tenant changes are prohibited.

An authorized Power Platform administrator can do it in **Power Platform admin center → Environment → Settings → Users + permissions → Users → select user → Manage security roles → System Administrator → Save**. Confirm the correct environment and user before assigning this highly privileged role.
